attributes.name: Jestak
attributes.powers:
Damage dealt by Jestak may not be reduced.

If undefeated, shuffle Jestak into a random other open location, if there is one.

If defeated, summon the henchman Janeamine and shuffle her into a random open location, then you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
